en: Bamboo is the fastest-growing plant and can grow up to 91 centimeters in a single day.
A blue whale's tongue weighs as much as an entire African elephant.
The human body contains enough carbon to manufacture roughly 9,000 pencils.
Coral reefs support 25 percent of all marine life despite covering less than one percent of the ocean floor.
The Texas horned lizard can shoot blood from the corners of its eyes to deter predators.
Periodical cicada nymphs spend exactly 13 or 17 years underground before emerging as flying adults.
Vaccines train your immune system to recognize and fight specific viruses before they can make you sick.
The corpse flower takes up to ten years to bloom and emits a smell like rotting meat.
Microscopic water bears called tardigrades can survive the freezing vacuum of outer space for several days.
Scientists discovered the human nose can detect and remember over one trillion different scents.
Trees use an underground fungal network called the Wood Wide Web to share nutrients and send warnings.
A giraffe's 45-centimeter-long tongue is dark purple to prevent it from getting sunburned while eating.
